title: P5319 (SMDC) UKSPF Growing the local Social economy (LOT 1 E26) Plus Building and infrastructure (LOT 2 E11)
description:
Staffordshire Moorlands District Council (the Council) has been allocated funding from the UK Shared Prosperity Fund and the Rural England Prosperity Fund to:

1. Lot 1 Support and grow the local social economy, including for
community businesses, cooperatives and social enterprises (hereafter referred to as community businesses). The Council would like to see substantial growth in this sector leading to the creation of new and sustainable jobs within the sector. Commencing 1/4/2023 ending 31/3/2025. Note that these dates are subject to change.

And for,
2. Lot 2 Investment in capacity building and infrastructure support for local civil society. Commencing 1/4/2023 ending 31/3/2025.
The Council is seeking highly competent support providers to work with existing community businesses and civil society organisations and groups in Staffordshire Moorlands to provide advice and support.

The Council is seeking two specific yet inter-related support providers and the successful contractor/s may wish to bid as a consortium in order to provide the specialist support for both Lots 1 and 2. 

We may award to a lead contractor who would be responsible for the overall delivery of both lots.  Arrangements between the parties, if a consortium, would need to be specified as either a sub contract or service level agreement between the parties. The successful parties would be expected to work in partnership to avoid duplication.

description:
Derbyshire County Council (The Council) Children's Services Catering Service is seeking a supplier for the provision of the supply and delivery of groceries and provisions for schools and establishments located within the geographical area of Derbyshire and neighbouring counties.\r
\r
This contract will provide groceries and provisions to:\r
- Schools located within Derbyshire and in counties that share a boundary with Derbyshire, that trade with Derbyshire County Council Catering Service. Currently this is approximately 300 primary schools and 20 secondary schools.\r
- Derbyshire County Council's Social and Adult Care Services will use this contract for the supply to approximately 25 residential homes for older people and day centres.\r
- Countryside Services visitor centres at sites across Derbyshire including Elvaston Castle Country Park, Shipley Country Park, High Peak Junction Cromford, Middleton Top Wirksworth and Tapton Lock in Chesterfield.\r
- The contract will also be used by Derby City Council to supply products for their day centres and homes for older people.\r
\r
The contract shall be for an initial two-year period commencing on 29 February 2024, with the option to extend for two further two-year periods, up to a maximum of six years.
